_comment: What an /event/<id> response must carry before any script runs. Written before the Worker code; tools/event-head.mjs reads this file and never the other way round. `status`, `title`, `description`, `og_title`, `canonical` are compared exactly against the parsed HTML (entities decoded). `data: "down"` cases run against a Worker whose data host does not answer. Description rule (2026-11-19): name, year and place only, built from the archive's own fields; nothing organizer-written.

generic.title: EveryBadge - the POAP archive
generic.description: Every POAP event the archive captured: 197,589 events, their names, dates and artwork, browsable by anyone and stored so no single machine going away takes it down.
